name: Throttle Lever
description: The output ranges from -1 to 1, and will increase/decrease depending on which half of the lever you interact with. The two on/off inputs can be used to control the lever externally with different buttons. The speed of the lever can be configured by selecting this component with the select tool.
shortDescription: A throttle lever that acts as two buttons controlling one number output.

logicNodes.label: Up
logicNodes.description: Increases the Throttle Value when input is held.

logicNodes.label: Down
logicNodes.description: Decreases the Throttle Value when input is held.
